profile_text.body:
Coursera is an online learning platform. Its website describes offerings of online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The site says learners use these programs to build job-ready skills in fields such as project management, UX design, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering. Coursera Plus is described as an annual subscription with unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's site highlights AI-related content, including generative AI courses, an AI Essentials Specialization, an AI Engineer Professional Certificate, a Machine Learning Specialization, and a Deep Learning Specialization. It also lists artificial intelligence as a broad browsing area and names Anthropic among partner organizations.

Coursera is a public company traded as COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001651562. California records show 281 legal matters involving Coursera.
